create.name: Lihi Benisty
create.bio:
Lihi Benisty is a Los Angeles teacher of breathwork, movement and somatic self-inquiry, and a first-generation American. Her movement classes draw on vinyasa, hatha, yin and restorative yoga and on Pilates, with ideas borrowed from capoeira, the Ido Portal method and the Gaga dance language. Her breathwork ranges from slow, settling practices to longer active journeys, and she has taught both in studios and on the Open app. She also leads sound meditations using gongs, chimes, bowls, kalimba and her own voice.

In private self-inquiry sessions she uses dialogue and attention to the body, drawing on parts work and Gestalt, so that clients can recognise their own patterns, and she mentors new and established teachers online. Writing runs alongside the practice: in 2025 she published her first poetry collection, The Self, Reframed: In the Realm of Raw, and she writes a Substack newsletter that treats self-inquiry as a kind of gardening. At Esalen she has led weekend and week-long programmes combining breathwork, movement, writing and sound, and she records personalised guided meditations for individual clients.

books.title: the self, reframed: in the realm of raw
books.author: Lihi Benisty
books.description: Her first book, a short self-published collection of poems from 2025. The poems look at hard moments and vulnerability and how a change of view can turn them towards connection, echoing the themes of her somatic classes.

courses.title: The Inner Atlas: Mapping the Self through Somatic Self-Inquiry
courses.description: A five-day residential workshop at Esalen in Big Sur. Each day explores a different layer of experience through breathwork, movement, writing, sound and partner exercises, and participants build a personal body map to take home.

courses.title: personalized audio recording
courses.description: A guided meditation or breathwork recording made for one person after an initial conversation about what they are going through. It blends breath, body awareness and imagery, and arrives as an audio file to keep.

free_resources.title: seeds of the self
free_resources.description: Her free Substack newsletter of reflective essays and poetry on self-inquiry, using the garden as its running image.
